app.title: gitid
noGit.lede: gitid needs git, and couldn't find it.
noGit.body: Install git from git-scm.com (on a Mac, running {command} also works) and reopen gitid, or tell gitid where git is.
copy.title: Copy to clipboard
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.label: Show gitid in
settings.language.help: The language of gitid's own screens. git's messages and your config are shown as they are.
role.author: author
field.author.name: author name
field.committer.name: committer name
warning.missing: git will refuse to commit: there's no usable {role} identity.
warning.guessed: The {field} isn't set, so git is guessing it from your computer's login.
warning.fromEnv: The {field} comes from the environment variable {var}. Other terminals and apps may see something different.
warning.injected: The {field} is set by git -c or a GIT_CONFIG_* variable ({key}), not by a config file.
warning.authorCommitterDiffer: The author and committer differ in this folder.
warning.guessingAllowed: {key} is off, so git will quietly guess an identity whenever none is configured.
rule.line.server: Repos with a remote on {host} (https, http or ssh)
rule.line.serverPort: Repos with a remote on {host} (https, http or ssh, SSH port {port})
rule.line.remoteUrl: Repos with a remote URL matching {pattern}
setting.user.name.label: Name
setting.user.name.help: Used for commits wherever no rule or repository sets one.
setting.user.email.label: Email
setting.user.email.help: Used for commits wherever no rule or repository sets one.
setting.user.useConfigOnly.label: Never guess my identity
setting.user.useConfigOnly.help: When no name or email is configured, git refuses to commit instead of making one up from your computer's login.
setting.init.defaultBranch.label: Default branch name
setting.init.defaultBranch.help: The first branch of new repositories. git's own default is master.
setting.pull.rebase.label: When pulling
setting.pull.rebase.help: How git pull combines your local commits with new ones from the remote.
setting.core.editor.label: Editor
setting.core.editor.help: The program git opens for commit messages, for example nano, vim or code --wait.
setting.commit.gpgSign.label: Sign every commit
setting.commit.gpgSign.help: Adds a signature to each commit, which Gitea and GitHub show as verified.
setting.gpg.format.label: Signature type
setting.gpg.format.help: What kind of key signs your commits.
setting.user.signingKey.label: Signing key
setting.user.signingKey.help: A GPG key ID, or for SSH signing, the path to your public key (e.g. ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub).
error.unexpectedOutput: git answered in a way gitid didn't expect.
error.gitNotFound: git wasn't found on this computer.
error.notADirectory: {path} isn't a folder, or no longer exists.
error.unsupported: {feature} needs git {needs} or newer; this computer has {have}.
error.multipleValues: {key} has several values. Remove the extra ones first.
error.badKey: git doesn't accept {key} as a config key.
error.pathNotUtf8: {path} can't be saved in git config, because its name isn't valid UTF-8.
error.staleValue: That value changed since the list was loaded. The list has been refreshed.
error.needsRepoFolder: Choose a folder inside a repository first.
error.unknownSetting: {key} isn't one of the settings gitid manages.
error.badEmail: “{email}” doesn't look like an email address.
error.badRuleId: “{id}” can't be a rule ID. Use letters, digits, - and _ (like work or gitea).
error.ruleNeedsIdentity: A rule needs a name, an email, or both.
error.badRuleName: The name can't be empty or contain <, > or line breaks.
error.ruleNeedsWhere: A rule needs at least one folder or server.
error.badServer: “{input}” isn't a server name. Enter something like gitea.example.com or gitea.example.com:3000.
error.badPort: The port in “{input}” isn't a number.
error.noHome: gitid can't find your home folder (HOME isn't set).
